description: Import handover orders from Google Sheets CSV. The function maps Arabic column titles to database fields, validates each row, and skips/updates existing orders based on order_number. Errors are logged per row and processing continues for remaining rows.

parameters.paramDescription: The Google Sheets shareable URL. The function will automatically convert it to CSV export format.
The city name to filter workers and waste types by (e.g., 'الإسكندرية')

responseDescription: Returns import results including: success (true if no errors), imported count (new records), updated count (existing records updated), errors array (with row number, error message, and row data for each error), and total_rows_processed. The function maps Arabic column titles: 'التاريخ'→order_date, 'المندوب'→worker, 'نوع المخلف'→waste_type, 'وزن المفروز'→sorted_weight, 'وزن المرفوض'→rejected_weight, 'ملحوظات'→notes, 'وقت الإرسال'→send_time, 'المرسل'→sender, 'رقم الطلب'→order_number. If an order with the same order_number exists, it will be updated instead of creating a duplicate.

description: Get warehouse configuration including last update information and automatic updates settings
responseDescription: Returns warehouse configuration including: last_update_date (when the last import was done), last_update_type ('automatic' for cron job or 'manual' for dashboard trigger), automatic_updates_enabled (whether cron job is enabled), last_update_status (status message), and counts from last import (imported, updated, errors)

description: Update warehouse configuration, primarily to enable/disable automatic updates (cron job)

parameters.paramDescription: Enable or disable automatic updates (cron job that runs every 6 hours)

responseDescription: Returns updated warehouse configuration

description: Manually trigger import from Google Sheets for both cities (Damnhour and Alexandria). This imports from both pre-configured sheets and marks the update as 'manual' in the configuration.
responseDescription: Returns import results for both cities. The function automatically imports from: Damnhour sheet (دمهور) and Alexandria sheet (الإسكندرية). Each city result includes success status, imported count, updated count, and errors count. This is the same as the automatic cron job but can be triggered manually from the dashboard.

description: Get all WasteBags currently in PENDING_HANDOVER status that are directed to a specific warehouse. These are bags waiting for the warehouse to record weights.

description: Warehouse records the received weights for each waste type in a bag. Updates warehouse_received_weight on each WasteBagItem, computes total_price using warehouse price list, and changes bag status to CONFIRMING. Requires WAREHOUSE write permission.

parameters.paramDescription: The bag ID (must be in PENDING_HANDOVER status)
The warehouse recording the weights
Array of {waste_type: String, warehouse_received_weight: Float} — one entry per waste type

responseDescription: Returns the bag ID, new status (CONFIRMING), and computed total_price. The price is computed as sum(warehouse_received_weight × price_per_kg) for each waste type using the warehouse's configured prices.

description: Warehouse rejects a bag before weighing (e.g., quality gate rejection). Creates a HandoverTicket with reason WAREHOUSE_REJECTED and resets bag to HOLDING status. Requires WAREHOUSE write permission.

parameters.paramDescription: The bag ID (must be in PENDING_HANDOVER status)
The warehouse rejecting the bag
Optional. Reason for rejection

responseDescription: Returns 'Done'. A HandoverTicket is created. Bag status reverts to HOLDING and warehouse is set to null, allowing the worker to try another warehouse.

description: Get all HandoverTickets. Optionally filter by bagID, warehouseID, or reason. Tickets are ordered by newest first.

Optional. Filter by specific warehouse ID

responseDescription: Returns an array of HandoverTicket objects. Reason values: WORKER_REFUSED (worker rejected warehouse weights), WAREHOUSE_REJECTED (warehouse refused the bag before weighing).
